title: VA PTSD program with flashing images and air horns

tellings.quote: And they put me in this weird program back in 2016, 2017 where they're flashing images and air horns.

plain: Dylan Borland, a military veteran, says that in 2016 and 2017 the VA, the US government department that cares for veterans, put him in a strange programme for PTSD, a disorder that follows trauma. He says it involved flashing images and air horns, and he ties it to Langley, home of the CIA, the US spy agency, citing his VA medical records. If true, it would suggest he was being tested rather than simply treated.
